housing.summary: Numbeo's July 2026 Enschede table reports EUR 1,172 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre; Pararius provides current Enschede rental listings; a deposit norm was not grounded in the cited sources.

banking.summary: ABN AMRO's official account-opening page requires an accepted identity document and, for a non-Dutch passport or ID, proof of residence in the Netherlands; a BSN may be supplied within 120 days after opening.
required_docs: Accepted identity document: Dutch ID, eligible European identity card, international passport, or residence permit
Proof of residence in the Netherlands when applying with a non-Dutch passport or ID
Citizen Service Number (BSN), which ABN AMRO allows to be supplied within 120 days after opening

schools.summary: International School Twente is based in Enschede and states that its established International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme is the final programme students complete before graduation.

legal_admin.summary: A person moving to Enschede from another country must make an appointment and register in person with the municipality; accompanying family members must also register.
legal_admin.registration_step: Make an appointment and register in person with the Municipality of Enschede after moving from another country.

tax_finance.summary: The Dutch Tax Administration identifies the Citizen Service Number (BSN) as the personal government number and says newcomers receive one when they register with a Dutch municipality; people staying under four months can apply at an RNI desk.

transport.summary: Numbeo's July 2026 Enschede table reports EUR 100 as the regular monthly public-transport pass price; the network name, driving-licence exchange rule, and healthcare registration process were not grounded in the cited city source.
